projection: camera-facing 2:1 cinematic matte; aspect-preserving center crop, not equirectangular
shared_art_direction: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished in-game space background matte for a top-down mobile sci-fi MOBA, Dimensions Front. ONE coherent wide landscape image, 2:1 aspect ratio, edge-to-edge. Premium detailed astronomical matte painting with physically plausible space light, intricate nebula dust filaments, crisp tiny stars, sophisticated restrained palette and visual depth. A calm dark central area must stay readable behind a floating arena; put the distinctive large celestial shapes toward the lower sides and outer frame. NOT an equirectangular image: this is a camera-facing cinematic wide background. The image will be cropped to different landscape phone screens, so keep the main planetary feature within the middle 80% of the width and avoid important content at the extreme edge. No UI, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no border, no characters, no foreground terrain, no buildings, no spaceships, no collage, no baked shooting stars or bright streaks. Keep peak lights localized and the overall space dark, never a flat colorful wash.

artwork.name: Menu
artwork.generation_prompt: Edit the supplied space artwork for the main menu of Dimensions Front. Keep the same premium detailed astronomical matte-painting style, 2:1 wide composition, crisp tiny stars and restrained navy, violet and cyan palette. The user explicitly wants MULTIPLE PLANETS AND MORE STARS: the current image feels too empty. Make the entire composition visibly richer and fuller. Add FIVE clearly distinct planets at different sizes and depths: a prominent elegantly ringed blue-violet gas giant in the lower LEFT quadrant with much of its disk visible; a medium rocky copper-brown crescent in the lower RIGHT; a smaller violet world above and left of center; a small silver moon toward the upper right inside the crop-safe area; a small teal distant world to the right of center. Add delicate extra moonlets near the large planets, denser fine star fields and recognizable star clusters across the whole image, including the center. Extend wispy luminous dust and a soft Milky Way ribbon diagonally through the center so there is no huge empty black hole. Keep layered depth and photographic astronomical detail, not a diagram or collage. UI readability still matters: planet surfaces mostly dark, brightest rims and nebula patches localized, medium-dark calm contrast behind future interface text. No text or interface in the actual image. No flares obscuring the scene, no spaceships, characters, buildings, terrain, borders or watermarks. No baked shooting-star streaks because those are animated separately. Preserve the existing nebula craftsmanship but change the layout substantially to satisfy the fuller multi-planet request.
artwork.revision: Five planets with moonlets, denser stars and a diagonal galactic dust ribbon, requested by user.
